Many Pines Campground is the most convenient for campers with large RVs along the US Highway 89 corridor.'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Potable water in the warmer months only; current conditions (October 2026): 'No potable water available. Fees still required.' Food storage order March 1 - December 1.

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/helena-lewisclark/recreation/many-pines-campground ('The campgrounds include access to potable water during the warmer months, and all have at least one handicap accessible vault toilet', 'Potable water is available at this site', Current Conditions 'No potable water available. Fees still required.'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Forest Service: 'The campground is usually open late May through October.' 'Open and close dates can vary depending on snowfall conditions.'

Forest Service-run. 'All campgrounds on the Helena-Lewis and Clark National Forest are first-come, first-served. Reservations are not available.' Self-serve fee station; the camper must be present to hold a site.

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/helena-lewisclark/recreation/many-pines-campground ('All campgrounds on the Helena-Lewis and Clark National Forest are first-come, first-served. Reservations are not available. Camping is limited to 16 consecutive days in one location.'), read 2026-10-22

note: Helena-Lewis and Clark National Forest campground in lodgepole pine directly off US-89 in the Belt Creek canyon near Neihart, ~5,800 ft; sites along Belt Creek (catch-and-release cutthroat). Memorial Falls trailhead ~1 mi north. --Claude
summary: Confirmed 23 sites, vault toilets and potable water (warmer months), FCFS/not reservable, $15/night (fees already human-checked). Added max_rig_ft 51, 16-day limit, season late May through October. Not stated: hookups (derived none left). Note trimmed of restated values.
